notes_for_editor: Dates and design agree across four history sources (idahofirelookouts.com, firelookout.com, the 2016 Forest Service list, and the Idaho Lookouts Clearwater County page); the FFLA list supplies the 'Tower Gone' status. Today's condition rests on the FFLA line and the 'Drive-Up Ruins' label only. FFLA coordinates 46.57248, -115.60205 differ from the record's 46.87201, -115.97122 by roughly 35 km; not resolved and the record was not changed. The FS list places the site in T37N R7E Sec 5 but this was not converted to coordinates. firelookout.com's 'Headquarters' reference is not identified, so it is left out. No staffing history documented; staffing status is 'unknown' with the Idaho page date as as_of.
